quote: This review describes those ligands and receptors involved in the resolution of inflammation, and highlights the most recent clinical trial results.
summary: Review of pro-resolving mediator receptors including FPR2/ALX as drug targets; no new data.

quote: FPR2/ALX is proatherogenic due to effects on bone marrow-derived cells, but promoted a more stable plaque phenotype through effects on SMCs.
summary: Fpr2 deletion delayed atherosclerosis but reduced plaque collagen, showing a dual role; FPR2 mRNA was also raised in human plaques. Not a gut study.

quote: Colonic epithelial cells in FPR2-deficient mice displayed defects in commensal bacterium-dependent homeostasis as shown by the absence of responses to N-formylpeptide stimulation, shortened colonic crypts, reduced acute inflammatory responses to dextran sulfate sodium (DSS) challenge, delayed mucosal restoration after injury, and increased azoxymethane-induced tumorigenesis.
summary: FPR2-deficient mice show impaired colonic epithelial renewal, delayed mucosal repair after DSS and more tumours, though acute DSS inflammation was reduced; FPR2 supports epithelial homeostasis.

quote: We also show that aspirin-triggered 15-epi-lipoxin A4 (15-epi-LXA4) and 17-epi-resolvin D1 (17-epi-RvD1) through the receptor ALX/FPR2 antagonize cues from CpG DNA, preserve C5aR expression, restore impaired phagocytosis, and redirect human PMNs to apoptosis.
summary: Pro-resolving lipids acting through ALX/FPR2 restore neutrophil phagocytosis and speed resolution of lung inflammation; not a gut study.

quote: Our results demonstrate a specific up-regulation of this pro-resolution circuit in individuals in remission from UC, and suggest a significant role for LXA(4) and AnxA1 in promoting mucosal homeostasis.
summary: Mucosal LXA4 and AnxA1 are raised in UC remission biopsies, and FPR2/ALX receptor expression was assessed in the same circuit.

quote: The interaction between mite FABPs and SAA1 activated the SAA1-binding receptor, formyl peptide receptor 2 (FPR2), which drove the epithelial release of the type-2-promoting cytokine interleukin (IL)-33 in a SAA1-dependent manner.
summary: FPR2 activation by SAA1 and mite allergens drove epithelial IL-33 release and type 2 immunity in airway cells; unrelated to UC.

quote: LXA₄ decreased IgM and IgG production on activated human B cells through ALX/FPR2-dependent signaling, which downregulated NF-κB p65 nuclear translocation.
summary: Lipoxin A4 reduced antibody production by memory B cells through ALX/FPR2, a pro-resolving action on adaptive immunity.

quote: Here we report that formyl peptide receptor 2 (Fpr2/3) null mice display a major phenotype with exacerbated vascular inflammation observed postischemia reperfusion (IR) injury of the mesenteric artery, characterized by marked neutrophil adhesion and extravasation as visualized by intravital microscopy.
summary: Fpr2/3 knockout mice had worse mesenteric ischaemia-reperfusion vascular inflammation, which lipoxin A4 reduced only in mice with the receptor.

quote: Here, we identify pericryptal CD34+ Gp38+ αSMA- mesenchymal cells closely associated with Lgr5+ IESCs.
summary: Gp38 (podoplanin) marks a pericryptal mesenchymal stem cell niche population in mouse intestine; the gene itself was not tested.

quote: B-cell activation was followed by expansion of circulating CD45-CD31-PDPN+ preinflammatory mesenchymal, or PRIME, cells in the blood from patients with rheumatoid arthritis; these cells shared features of inflammatory synovial fibroblasts.
summary: PDPN is used as a surface marker of circulating PRIME cells before rheumatoid arthritis flares; not about the gene's function or UC.

quote: The monoclonal antibody D2-40 is a specific lymphatic endothelial markers and D2-40 staining have been applicable to evaluate lymphatic invasion in various malignant neoplasms.
summary: D2-40 (podoplanin) staining was used to detect lymphatic invasion in gastric cancer; not related to UC.

quote: Increased density of lymphatic vessels is a constant feature of IBD and is present in non-inflamed areas.
summary: Podoplanin and D2-40 staining showed increased lymphatic vessel density in Crohn's disease and UC tissue, mucosal in UC; podoplanin mRNA was also measured.

quote: The median number of lymphatics was significantly higher both in ileal and colic samples of CD than the other inflammatory diseases as well as normal controls.
summary: D2-40 (podoplanin) staining shows higher lymphatic vessel density in Crohn's disease than in other IBD or normal tissue.

quote: Tissue sections were immunostained with a lymphatic endothelial cell marker (D2-40), a marker for blood vasculature (FVIII), and markers for T cells (CD3), B cells (CD20) and macrophages (CD68).
summary: D2-40 is used only as a lymphatic marker in Crohn's disease sections to show lymphatic inflammation and granulomas.

quote: Decreased LV density is associated with high risk of endoscopic recurrence after surgery.
summary: D2-40-stained lymphatic vessel density in the uninflamed ileal margin was associated with postoperative endoscopic recurrence in Crohn's disease.

quote: We found significantly increased numbers of lymph vessels in chronic active ulcerative colitis both within the lamina propria and the submucosa as compared to normal mucosa.
summary: D2-40-positive lymphatic vessels are increased in active UC and fall as architecture is restored.

quote: The gut microbiota interacts with host immune pathways, influencing morphogens, glycosylation, and podoplanin (PDPN) expression.
summary: Review on microbiota in IBD that briefly links microbiota to PDPN expression and states aberrant PDPN activity may worsen inflammation.

quote: Cumulative evidence supports that platelets can directly interact with PDPN-expressing cancer cells via C-type lectin-like receptor 2 (CLEC2), contributing to cancer cell invasion and metastasis.
summary: Review of the platelet CLEC2-podoplanin axis as a target in oral cancer; no UC content.

quote: It requires STAT3 phosphorylation in epithelial cells in response to IL-22 and IL-11 expressed by lamina propria gp38+ stromal cells.
summary: gp38 marks stromal cells that produce IL-22 and IL-11 in a Listeria infection response; the gene itself was not tested.

quote: Immunohistochemistry employed D2-40 antibody to label lymphatics and anti-CD68 to label granulomas.
summary: D2-40 is used only to label lymphatics in Crohn's disease sections showing granuloma obstruction.
gp38 here is a phage tail fiber protein, not podoplanin.

quote: IL-17 secretion is restored with shRNA gene silencing of PDPN.
summary: PDPN silencing restored IL-17 secretion and CLEC-2 ligation dampened Th17 responses, so PDPN limits Th17 inflammation in human T cells.

quote: Indeed, we found that Hedgehog-responsive cells expressed gp38, smooth muscle actin, and desmin, indicating a fibroblastic nature.
summary: gp38 is used as a marker of Hedgehog-responsive fibroblasts in DSS colitis; the gene itself was not tested.
gp38 here is a phage host-recognition protein, not podoplanin.

quote: Here we show that lymphatic vessel endothelial receptor 1 (LYVE1)+ /podoplanin (PDPN)+ lymphatic vessels (LVs) are increased in the periodontal tissues, with accumulation close to the alveolar bone surface, in two murine periodontitis models: rheumatoid arthritis (RA)-associated periodontitis and ligature-induced periodontitis.
summary: PDPN+ lymphatic vessels increase in inflamed periodontal tissue in mouse models; PDPN is a lymphatic marker and the study is not about gut disease.
